result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed roadway environment completely lacking pedestrian infrastructure. A guardrail directly abuts the travel lane, forcing any pedestrians to walk in the roadway with no safe refuge from vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or paved shoulder, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Guardrail Entrapment
hazards.description: The guardrail prevents pedestrians from stepping off the roadway to avoid oncoming traffic, effectively trapping them in the lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Running along the right edge of the pavement

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible longitudinal and transverse cracking in the asphalt surface.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground of the roadway

interventions.title: Multi-use Path Construction
interventions.description: Construct a separated multi-use path or sidewalk behind the guardrail or by widening the road cross-section to provide safe pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility of pedestrians for drivers, particularly given the dense roadside vegetation.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracking and provide a smoother surface for all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed, curved roadway segment with no pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks or marked crossings. A continuous guardrail and dense vegetation along the roadside create a constrained environment with poor sightlines and no safe refuge for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian separation
hazards.description: No sidewalk or shoulder exists, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with high-speed vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the guardrail

hazards.name: Restricted sight lines
hazards.description: The combination of a road curve and dense roadside vegetation limits the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right background where the road curves

interventions.title: Separated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk or multi-use path physically separated from the roadway to provide a safe walking environment.

interventions.title: Roadway Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for all road users, especially around curves and in wooded areas.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signs. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked cars near the corners create a high-risk environment for pedestrians crossing between apartment complexes.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated or marked crossing area at a wide intersection between residential buildings.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the sidewalk inaccessible for wheelchair users or those with strollers at the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: The lack of stop signs or traffic signals combined with a wide roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate vehicle flow at the intersection.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure at a residential intersection. While a sidewalk exists on one side, there are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals to facilitate safe movement across the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross the main roadway at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The transition from the sidewalk to the street lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps, creating a barrier for mobility-impaired users.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground at the corner of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Limited sight lines
hazards.description: The curve in the road combined with roadside vegetation may limit the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road following the curve
